techniques.name: Brute Force
techniques.justification: Logs show repeated failed login attempts for the root user from an external IP address, indicating an unauthorized brute-force attack.

techniques.name: Active Scanning
techniques.justification: Cluster represents unauthorized external port scanning against the ssh-srv host.

techniques.name: Brute Force
techniques.justification: Multiple failed password attempts followed by a successful login for the deploy user from an external IP address.

techniques.name: External Remote Services
techniques.justification: External remote service access via SSH following brute-force compromise.

techniques.name: Sudo and Sudo Caching
techniques.justification: User deploy executed sudo to escalate privileges to root outside standard sysadmin administrative workflows.

techniques.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
techniques.justification: Unauthorized egress traffic with large data volume to an external suspicious IP and port.

techniques.name: Password Spraying
techniques.justification: Credential spraying pattern targeting multiple internal users from an external IP.

techniques.name: Active Scanning
techniques.justification: External port scanning activity from an external IP against ssh-srv.

techniques.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
techniques.justification: SQL injection exploitation payloads and sqlmap user-agent signatures observed against web-srv.

techniques.name: File and Directory Discovery
techniques.justification: Directory traversal attack attempting to read sensitive system files such as /etc/passwd on web-srv.
